newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-More Australian offshore drilling seen.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-More Australian offshore drilling seen.

text.p: A rise in Australian offshore petroleum seismic survey activity indicated good prospects for an increase in the level of offshore exploration and drilling, the Bureau of Resource Sciences said on Thursday.

"So far this year, 166,024 line-km of offshore seismic survey were recorded which bodes well for the prospect of a future increase in the level of offshore exploration and drilling," the bureau said in a statement.
The level of offshore seismic activity to June was the second highest ever recorded by the bureau, it said.
Offshore exploration drilling during the last six months accounted for 24 wells, six wells fewer than the same period last year.
Onshore exploration drilling by June accounted for 26 wells, 19 wells fewer than the same period last year.
"The overall level of drilling in the first six months of 1996 was nine percent lower than for the same period last year," the spokesman said.
"In the first half of 1996, there have been three offshore and six onshore new-field discoveries," he said.
The spokesman said large surveys were being made in the Ashmore-Cartier area of the Timor Sea, and the Browse and Carnarvon Basins off northwestern Australia.
